purpose: Macitentan is used to treat pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH), which is high blood pressure in the arteries that supply your lungs. It helps slow down the worsening of this condition and reduces the need for hospitalization. It can help you breathe more easily and stay more active.
how_it_works: Your body makes a natural chemical called endothelin that can cause the blood vessels in your lungs to tighten and narrow. Macitentan blocks the receptors that endothelin attaches to, so those vessels can relax and widen. This makes it easier for your heart to pump blood through your lungs, lowering the pressure.
common_side_effects: Common side effects include anemia (low red blood cell count, which can make you feel tired or weak), nasal congestion or stuffy nose, sore throat, headache, urinary tract infections, and swelling in the legs or ankles.
warnings: This medication can cause serious birth defects and must NEVER be taken during pregnancy. You must use two reliable forms of birth control while taking it and have regular pregnancy tests. Macitentan can also lower your red blood cell count significantly, so your doctor will check your blood regularly. It can affect your liver, so liver tests will also be monitored. Do not stop taking this medication without talking to your doctor first.
typical_dosing: The usual dose is one 10 mg tablet taken by mouth once daily, with or without food. Try to take it at the same time each day to help you remember.
